statement: (n : Int) : Exists (fun k : Int => n <= k ∧ k < n+5 ∧ k % 5 = 2)
(xs acc : List Nat) : qrev xs acc = app (rev xs) acc
prelude:
def app : List Nat -> List Nat -> List Nat
| [], ys => ys
| x :: xs, ys => x :: app xs ys
def rev : List Nat -> List Nat
| [] => []
| x :: xs => app (rev xs) [x]
def qrev : List Nat -> List Nat -> List Nat
| [], acc => acc
| x :: xs, acc => qrev xs (x :: acc)
